sourceReviewSummary: We followed an official WCPSS Traditional school calendar page to the 2027–28 Traditional Calendar and manually checked the dates and calendar markings against the district PDF. The official PDF states a minimum requirement of 1,025 instructional hours and does not publish an official student-day total.
sourceReviewDetails: On August 9, 2026, the official WCPSS page linked resource UUID b3fba901-50b4-4bd6-835f-6b4f85f1dbdd. It resolved to the reviewed PDF with SHA-256 1bde054e001a91718b9b87195d1f4bc72757b2137cc35f7f0722c4380c5eea17.
PDF metadata date: April 8, 2026. This is recorded for technical provenance and is not presented as a district publication or revision date.
The resolved PDF was visually reviewed month by month, including first and last days, holidays, teacher workdays, vacation days, nine-week grading-period markers, and school return dates.

The derived 177-day count includes Monday–Friday dates from August 23, 2027 through June 8, 2028 and excludes each weekday marked H, W, or V on the official PDF. It also matches the four published nine-week totals: 44 + 44 + 44 + 45.

The official calendar identifies October 11, February 21, and April 3 as teacher workdays that may be used for weather makeup. The PDF also lists six banked instructional days and five remote instruction days, with the order determined by district leadership.

calendarFaqs.q: When does school start for WCPSS traditional-calendar students in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for WCPSS traditional-calendar students is Monday, August 23, 2027. The official PDF lists teacher workdays from August 16 through August 20 before students arrive.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for WCPSS in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for WCPSS traditional-calendar students is Thursday, June 8, 2028. The official PDF also marks the end of the fourth nine-week grading period on June 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCPSS spring break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: WCPSS spring break runs Monday, March 27 through Friday, March 31, 2028. April 3 is a teacher workday, so students are out through Monday, April 3 and classes resume Tuesday, April 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCPSS winter break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: WCPSS traditional-calendar students are out from Monday, December 20, 2027 through Monday, January 3, 2028 across teacher workdays, vacation days, and holidays. Classes resume Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCPSS Thanksgiving break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: WCPSS traditional-calendar students are out Wednesday, November 24 through Friday, November 26, 2027. November 24 is a teacher workday and November 25–26 are holidays on the district PDF. Classes resume Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does WCPSS start school before Labor Day?
calendarFaqs.a: North Carolina law generally allows traditional-calendar schools to open no earlier than the Monday closest to August 26. In 2027, that date is Monday, August 23, which is WCPSS's first student day for the 2027–28 Traditional Calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How are snow days or emergency school closings handled in Wake County?
calendarFaqs.a: For 2027–28, WCPSS identifies October 11, February 21, and April 3 as teacher workdays that may be used for weather makeup. When this page was reviewed on August 9, 2026, the calendar also listed six banked instructional days and five remote instruction days. District leadership determines how weather-makeup options are used after a closure.

whatsNew.title: What's New vs. 2026–27
content: School starts one day earlier than in 2026–27: August 23 instead of August 24.
The school year also ends one day earlier: June 8 instead of June 9.
The winter no-school period runs December 20–January 3; the prior calendar listed December 21–January 1.
The official spring vacation block moves to March 27–31, followed by a teacher workday on April 3. Good Friday falls later, on April 14.

customSections.label: Weather Makeup Days
customSections.content:
WCPSS identifies October 11, February 21, and April 3 as teacher workdays that may be used for weather makeup. They remain student no-school days unless district leadership changes the calendar after a closure.

When this page was reviewed on August 9, 2026, the 2027–28 Traditional Calendar listed six banked instructional days and five remote instruction days. The calendar states a minimum requirement of 1,025 instructional hours and does not publish an official student-day total.

calendarNotes:
This page covers the WCPSS 2027–28 Traditional Calendar. WCPSS publishes separate year-round, modified, and specialized calendars with different dates.

Traditional-calendar students start August 23, 2027 and finish June 8, 2028. Students are out November 24–26 around Thanksgiving, December 20–January 3 for the winter no-school period, and March 27–31 for spring break. Students resume classes April 4 after the April 3 teacher workday.
